proposal.observation: Phase 1 closed: parent NaFadeNet+ExtrapGate(s=50) 3-split val MAPE 0.1087 ± 0.0085, Acc@15 0.729 ± 0.025. Held-out what-if violation rates of the parent (NA-E009/E010/E011): P0 0.000/0.000/0.002, P4 0/0/0, P4b 0/0/0, P0c 0.000/0.000/0.003 — the capacity-fade rules already hold by construction (extrapolation gate + capacity-ratio inputs), so these losses cannot lower violations. P2 voltage sag: 0.836/0.203/0.051 (mean 0.36) — the model often predicts LONGER life when discharge voltage sags.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: The label-free rule P2 (a uniform extra drop of discharge voltage on observed cycles 11+, i.e. higher polarisation, must not lengthen predicted life), balanced by gradients (rho = 0.5), lowers the P2 held-out violation rate by >= 50% without making val MAPE worse.
proposal.question_inherited: Which registered physics rule does the parent actually break, and can a loss fix it without hurting accuracy?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Physical consistency of the parent under what-if fade is unmeasured; worst cells remain extreme-EOL ones.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Phase 2 start (user go 2026-11-08). loss.md §4.6 order is P0 -> P4 -> P0c -> P2, but the measured parent violation rates show P0/P4/P0c are already satisfied (nothing to improve, the §5.3 'violation rate falls' criterion cannot be met), so the evidence-led first test is P2.
proposal.modification: Loss = Relative Huber(0.15) + lambda * P2, P2 = mean ReLU(f(x_tilde) - sg[f(x)]), x_tilde: discharge voltage channel of observed cycles minus beta * r_n, r_n = clip((n-10)/90, 0, 1), beta ~ U(0, beta_max), beta_max = P90 of the training-cell drop in mean normalised discharge voltage cycle 10 -> 100; lambda = 0.5 * median grad-norm ratio on 3 fixed training batches (loss.md §5.2). Model unchanged (NA-E009 config).
proposal.held_constant_components: NA-E009 model and config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2021 MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E009 (0.0999 / 22.5 / 0.743); P2 held-out violation rate vs NA-E009 0.836; balance band R_P2 median in [0.05, 2.0], active fraction, cosine (loss.md §5.3).
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if split-2021 MAPE > 0.0999 + 0.005, or BALANCE_FAIL, or the P2 violation rate does not fall by >= 50% vs NA-E009 (0.836). Otherwise confirm on 42/2024 (parent rates 0.203 / 0.051).
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
